commandOrSteps: Dev/API: set E2E_PREVIEW_MODE=development, E2E_PREVIEW_PORT=4197, VITTRADE_E2E_DEV_AUTH=true and run node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/e2e/auth-session.spec.ts. Production smoke: set E2E_PREVIEW_MODE=production, E2E_PREVIEW_PORT=4198, clear VITTRADE_E2E_DEV_AUTH and run node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test.
environment: Windows 11 PowerShell; Node v24.19.0; Vite 6.4.3; Playwright 1.63.0; local Chromium; Dev/API requests to https://e2e.test intercepted by Playwright route fixtures; staging-mode preview build used for production smoke; backend and staging services disconnected.
expected: Development/API auth browser coverage includes the four registration challenge and rejection cases. The staging/production smoke profile keeps registration behind IntegrationPendingPage and skips only those development-only cases.
actual: The Dev/API auth-session suite passed 17/17, including email and phone challenge issuance, status-only registration 400 and 429, and zero verifyMfa calls before OTP submission. The full staging-preview E2E suite completed 59 passed and 4 skipped out of 63; the skipped cases are the four Dev/API-only registration tests. All E2E API requests were handled by Playwright fixtures; no backend or staging request was made.

externalEvidence.skippedCases: Development/API-only registration scenarios; registration routes intentionally remain pending in the staging/production route tree.

notes: Local browser evidence against Playwright fixtures. It verifies frontend request shaping, challenge rendering and route-profile separation only. It does not verify backend registration, session-cookie issuance or attributes, OTP lifecycle, idempotency retention/replay/deduplication, staging, production or user acceptance. The owner decision to use a session cookie resolves only the credential choice; no OTP verification was submitted.
